questions.q: During the decision-making process, why is it necessary to 'evaluate alternatives' before making a final choice?
options: To ensure that all choices are completely ignored.
To allow someone else to make the choice for you.
To weigh the pros and cons (advantages and disadvantages) of each possible option to select the best one.
To waste as much time as possible.
questions.explain: Evaluating alternatives involves comparing the potential outcomes, costs, and benefits of different solutions, allowing the decision-maker to choose the most effective and resource-efficient option.

questions.q: Physical energy is considered an essential human resource. How is this resource best conserved when executing household chores?
options: By using labor-saving devices, working systematically, and maintaining proper posture.
By refusing to eat completely before working.
By attempting to do all chores simultaneously in a chaotic rush.
questions.explain: Energy conservation in home management involves using efficient tools (like blenders or washing machines), planning tasks logically, and using proper body mechanics to avoid fatigue.
